title: Kannonji Castle
scope: Standing remains of Kannonji Castle around the traditional Honmaru and Hirai-maru, including the main stairs, shorter gate stair, and surviving retaining walls.
limitations: Stone outlines and stairs follow the mapped routes through the retained historic site. Individual stones, the surviving masonry height where terrain is coarse, and exact ramp geometry between surveyed edges are estimates.
The model covers the surviving stonework in the central Honmaru and Hirai-maru area. The nearby Buddhist temple, outer enclosures and lost buildings are outside its scope.
